78.translation: Equal toward all beings, he obtains supreme devotion to Me. Through devotion he knows Me in truth, how great I am and who I am. Because of such separate designation, knowledge and devotion are spoken of distinctly. Nor should contradiction with the Śruti be suspected: knowing Him alone, one crosses beyond death; no other path exists for going. Knowledge is an intermediate operation of devotion. When it is said that one cooks with pieces of wood, it is not thereby said that flames are not a means.
